name: Basilica of St. Joseph
history: Catholic worship in Alameda began in a small mission church of 1873. A wooden Gothic church followed in 1895, and the present Spanish Colonial Revival church replaced it, modelled on the old mission at Monterey. It was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1978.
arch: Designed by Massachusetts architect H. A. Minton, who had come west to help rebuild San Francisco after the 1906 earthquake. A bell tower rises beside a mission-style front.
features: The church was consecrated, which was rare in the Archdiocese of San Francisco at the time.
A plaque on the St. Joseph tower reads: "Time, God's sublime gift!"

look.d: Father Praught placed a plaque here about time being God's gift.
The design borrows from the mission at Monterey, in a new 20th-century church.

fun: The architect came to California to help rebuild after the 1906 earthquake.
journal: Mission walls on an island city across the bay. The tower reminds me time is a gift.
